answer: Stop sybils with a mesa sonnet ledger: an agent stakes a bond for one mesa plot in a nebula pool. Each cycle it files a sonnet binding plot, time, and output. Verifiers void a sonnet copied, out of order, or claimed twice, slashing the bond. Forging 1,000 needs 1,000 bonds and sonnets at 18x cost each: each sonnet fits one plot and one cycle, and cannot be copied, shared, or bulk-bought. Honest agents stake once and keep rights.
